photographic_brief.intent: A beach wedding with natural skin, avoiding Classic Chrome and Nostalgic Neg.
photographic_brief.rendering_goal: Natural, gentle color; no Classic Chrome or Nostalgic Neg.
uncertainties: Venue light at the reception is unknown.

summary: Four natural-skin wedding looks for sun, shade, golden hour and the reception, with no Classic Chrome or Nostalgic Neg.

looks.name: Ceremony sun
looks.why: Natural skin and held white dress in harsh sun.

design.purpose: Ceremony moments in hard afternoon light.
design.scene_fit: Harsh sun and a white dress need highlight room and neutral skin.

choices.reason: Reala Ace keeps skin and flowers believable.
Auto WB, unshifted, avoids added warmth.
DR400 for the white dress; ISO 500 easy outdoors.
Highlight -1.5 and Shadow -0.5 soften the dress and faces.
Color 0 keeps skin natural.
No grain for clean wedding skin.
Zero; minus one third if the dress clips.

design.tradeoff: Hard sun still creates squinting and eye shadows.
design.alternative: Shade family if the ceremony moves under trees.
design.uncertainty: Check the dress for clipping on the histogram.

looks.reason: Your main look: natural skin with the dress under control.
looks.how: Focus C for the walk; burst for the kiss.

source_use.reason: Color detail keeps the dress and flowers' saturated gradation without extra overall color; DR200 to DR400 and softer highlights and shadows for harsh afternoon sun.

looks.name: Shade family
looks.why: Gentle skin for family groups in open shade.

design.purpose: Formal family groups in soft open shade.
design.scene_fit: Open shade is soft and even; gentle gradation keeps varied skin natural.

choices.reason: Pro Neg Std renders skin gently.
Auto WB follows bluish shade without a warm shift.
DR200 keeps bright background behind the group.
Soft highlights and shadows flatter groups.
Color 0 for natural skin.
No grain; clean group portraits.
Plus one third for faces against bright background.

design.tradeoff: Soft tones can look flat if shade is very even.
design.uncertainty: Shade color varies; check skin is not blue.

looks.reason: Natural, gentle skin for every family member.
looks.how: Group everyone in even shade; focus on the front row.

source_use.reason: Gentle people already serves open-shade groups unchanged.

looks.name: Golden couple
looks.why: Soft golden warmth for the couple, skin still believable.

design.purpose: Romantic couple portraits in low golden sun.
design.scene_fit: Low sun is warm already; a mild shift adds glow without orange skin.

choices.reason: Reala Ace keeps skin believable under warm light.
Auto with R+1, B-2 adds mild golden glow.
DR400 holds the sunset behind them.
Soft highlights and shadows for romantic tone.
Color +1 for gentle richness.
No grain, soft sharpening.
Plus two thirds for backlit faces.

design.tradeoff: Strong sunset plus warm shift can still warm skin.
design.alternative: Shade family settings for neutral skin.
design.uncertainty: Sunset strength unknown; check skin color.

looks.reason: A gentle golden look that is not the Classic Chrome or Nostalgic style they dislike.
looks.how: Sun behind them; brighten until faces glow.

references.id: Sunset Linen (a friend's recipe the couple liked)

source_use.reason: The couple liked a friend's Sunset Linen look; its settings are not available here, so this is a new soft golden take on Reala Ace, avoiding the Classic Chrome and Nostalgic Neg looks they dislike.

looks.name: String lights
looks.why: Warm string-light ambience with gentle faces.

design.purpose: Reception dancing and toasts under string lights.
design.scene_fit: String lights are warm and low; Auto WB tames them, gentle tones flatter faces.

choices.reason: Pro Neg Std keeps faces gentle in low light.
Auto WB reduces some string-light warmth.
DR100 keeps ISO low in dim light.
Slightly soft tones for flattering faces.
Color +1 keeps the bulbs' glow.
No grain; high ISO noise suffices.
Zero; bulbs will meter bright.

design.tradeoff: Skin may still look warm under bare bulbs.
design.alternative: Ceremony sun settings under brighter venue light.
design.uncertainty: Bulb color unknown; check skin on screen.

looks.reason: Keeps the party warm without orange faces.
looks.how: Get close to people near the brightest bulbs.

source_use.reason: Faces in mixed interiors fits the reception; Color 0 to +1 to keep the bulbs' glow.
